title: SAR Doppler tomography paper on Vesuvius with the National Research Council of Italy

tellings.quote: um under the Vesuvius and I wrote a paper was very very nice paper and

plain: Filippo Biondi, an Italian scientist who works with satellite radar, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that before 2019 he wrote a paper with the National Research Council of Italy, the country's main public science body. He says it used radar images from satellites, together with readings from seismographs, instruments that record ground vibrations, to see what lies under the volcano Mount Vesuvius near Naples. He tells it to show that his method of looking deep underground worked before he turned it on the pyramids.
